item.title: Trump warns Iran of ‘bad things’ if no deal made, sets deadline of 10-15 days
item.description: US president urges Iranians to reach a 'meaningful' deal, stresses Tehran can't have nuclear weapons; Israel said on alert for Iranian preemptive attack The post Trump warns Iran of ‘bad things’ if no deal made, sets deadline of 10-15 days appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump announces $17 billion in pledges for Gaza at inaugural Board of Peace confab
item.description: Indonesia, Morocco, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Albania agree to contribute to Gaza security force; Top official: Project hinges on disarmament of Hamas, which will soon be presented with proposal The post Trump announces $17 billion in pledges for Gaza at inaugural Board of Peace confab appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump said considering initial targeted attack on Iran to force its hand on nuclear deal
item.description: WSJ says US president could ramp up strikes until Iranian regime is toppled or gives up its nuclear aspirations * Iran tells UN chief that all Mideast assets of ‘hostile force’ are fair game if US attacks The post Trump said considering initial targeted attack on Iran to force its hand on nuclear deal appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: High Court tells state to advance Western Wall egalitarian plaza upgrade, without further delays
item.description: Chief rabbis claim justices overstepped their authority with ruling, while Shas leader Aryeh Deri accuses them of trying to 'desecrate' Western Wall The post High Court tells state to advance Western Wall egalitarian plaza upgrade, without further delays appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Radical online content derails students hungry for info on Middle East conflict, study finds
item.description: Amid a sea of contradictory claims, high schoolers often believe whatever is most repeated in their social media feeds; better education is the answer, says Chapman University report The post Radical online content derails students hungry for info on Middle East conflict, study finds appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Settler activists, including far-right MK, illegally cross into Gaza
item.description: 'Gaza will always be ours,' declares Otzma Yehudit lawmaker, as settlement group announces 'giant march' in Strip over Passover; troops dispatched to the scene but no immediate comment from IDF The post Settler activists, including far-right MK, illegally cross into Gaza appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Security and antisemitism loom large in JFNA’s first ‘State of the Jewish Union’ address
item.description: Head of Jewish Federations of North America also emphasizes 'the emotional, familial and religious connection between the American Jewish community and the people of Israel' The post Security and antisemitism loom large in JFNA’s first ‘State of the Jewish Union’ address appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: After wartime slump, Israel’s housing market is ready for a reset in 2026, agents say
item.description: Real estate has cooled due to high interest rates, high prices and record supply levels, but optimism is up and prices are back on the rise The post After wartime slump, Israel’s housing market is ready for a reset in 2026, agents say appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Michael Oren: Israel’s historic Iran moment
item.description: A pro-Israel US president is poised to strike a weakened Iran, whose terror axis is crumbling. But Israel's enemies remain defiant, and both US parties could turn against it The post Michael Oren: Israel’s historic Iran moment appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53
item.description: 'Euphoria' actor announced he had Lou Gehrig’s disease last year and used his high profile to campaign for research; is said to have leaned on his Jewish faith after his diagnosis The post Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star and ALS awareness advocate, dies at 53 appeared first on The Times of Israel.
